reviewer.role: Fresh-context independent mathematical and editorial reviewer

findings.finding: Explanation named target 1 while the prompt approaches 2.
findings.resolution: Corrected the canonical generator to target 2.

findings.finding: A two-sided piecewise limit used generic one-sided language.
findings.resolution: Added explicit left- and right-hand calculations and equality conclusion.

findings.finding: The reported dimensions did not satisfy the stationarity equation; S'=0 gives r cubed equal to 108, not 72.
Four indefinite integrals incorrectly claimed endpoint evaluation.
findings.resolution: Restricted endpoint language to the three definite-integral records.

findings.finding: Template explanations did not prove the individual requested results.
findings.resolution: Replaced them with problem-specific computations, indexing, conditions, and units.

findings.finding: Template explanations did not document the individual transformation, endpoint, or error calculation.
findings.resolution: Replaced them with problem-specific derivations and endpoint tests.

findings.finding: Several sigma and limit prompts omitted bounds or the limiting variable.
findings.resolution: Added explicit lower/upper bounds and n approaching infinity.

findings.finding: The arctangent power-series answer omitted its endpoint convergence interval.
findings.resolution: Added the interval -1 through 1 and explicit endpoint review.

findings.finding: Prose conclusions were emitted as bare math identifiers.
findings.resolution: Wrapped prose in mathematical text markup.

findings.finding: Keys used method-only template cues instead of problem-specific derivations.
findings.resolution: Added the actual u, dv, intermediate integrals, repeated reductions, endpoint substitutions, and cyclic equations.

findings.finding: Exam keys used short method cues instead of showing the calculation or convergence hypotheses.
findings.resolution: Replaced all 50 cues with problem-specific computations, bounds, decompositions, and test conditions.
